profile.headline: Software Engineer - SRE at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary: I am a Software and Site Reliability Engineer with over a decade of experience building, supporting, and optimizing cloud-native systems in large-scale enterprise environments. My background spans SRE, software engineering, performance engineering, and infrastructure; giving me a holistic understanding of how reliable systems should be designed, deployed, monitored, and operated.I specialize in improving system resiliency, automating manual processes, reducing operational toil, and strengthening observability across Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud platforms, and distributed services. I’m passionate about building reliable platforms that enable teams to deliver software quickly, safely, and confidently.I thrive in collaborative environments where engineering, product, and operations partner closely, and I enjoy mentoring, documenting, and driving best practices across teams. Whether I’m leading an incident response, implementing CI/CD automation, or designing a new reliability workflow, my goal is always the same: create efficient, scalable systems that work every time.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead Chaos Engineering suite for the debit platform used to test and prove resiliency across application systems. Created 200+ chaos experiments testing Kubernetes clusters and failure injection across load balancers, Kafka, and network failures. 
•	Enhanced Jenkins pipeline to automate deployment of Chaos Testing framework and execution of chaos experiments to be executed before releases.
•	Manage observability tools and dashboards by reducing toil related to alerting in Splunk, Dynatrace, and Grafana.
•	Own infrastructure activities such as Disaster Recovery Plans/Audits/Activities, Data Center Migrations, and upgrades.
•	Working closely with application development teams to define Service Level Objectives and Error Budgets. Also works closely with the application support team on conducting blameless postmortems.

positions.title: IT App Development - Application Developer
positions.description:
• Works closely with Datapower, IBM MQ, and mainframe solutions to debug and resolve complex technical issues.
• Responsible for resource allocation, demand management, and designing / managing team processes and standards by integrating standard work into Rational Team Concert (RTC). Creating boards using LEAN /Agile principles.
• Lead all LEAN / Agile meetings such as standup, retrospective, and iteration meetings.
• Own team development and engagement plans as well as planning and coordinating team building activities and outings
• ETS API Hackathon Planning Committee
• ITDM 2020 Change Advisory Network Representative (ETS). ITDM2020 ChatBot Administrator
